fact: A seminar on artificial intelligence was conducted from 27 October to 5 November 2025 for some 100 public officers from different ministries and departments, and the Civil Service College trained 13,168 public officers in 2024-2025 against a target of 15,000 under the capacity development programme and e-learning.
title: Annual Report 2024-2025
publisher: Ministry of Public Service and Administrative Reforms
